lines.text:
Hiya!
You’re here to challenge the Gym, aren’t you?\c
I’m not a Trainer, but I can tell if you’re worthy
of challenging the Gym Leader.\c
Now, let’s get started...

The Pewter City Gym only allows Trainers who
know [VAR COLOR(0006)]type matchups[VAR COLOR(0000)] to enter!\c
There are a few types that have an advantage
against the Gym Leader’s [VAR COLOR(0006)]Rock-type[VAR COLOR(0000)] Pokémon.\c
But for Trainers who have never challenged a
Gym before, we have them use either [VAR COLOR(0006)]Grass- [VAR COLOR(0000)]or
[VAR COLOR(0006)]Water-type[VAR COLOR(0000)] Pokémon! You have to show me a
[VAR COLOR(0006)]Grass- [VAR COLOR(0000)]or [VAR COLOR(0006)]Water-type[VAR COLOR(0000)] Pokémon if you want to
face the Gym Leader!

Great!
That Pokémon is exactly what I wanted to see.[VAR SFX(0004)][VAR SFX(0001)]\c
Head on in! And aim to become
a Pokémon Champion!

...Do you not have one?[VAR SFX(0005)][VAR SFX(0000)]\c
You can find Grass-type Pokémon near
Pallet Town.\c
Come back once you’ve caught the Pokémon
you need. The Pewter City Gym will be waiting!
